
---

### Which file should I download?

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `AMBR-*-arm64.apk` | **AMBR**, the full app, for almost every phone from the last ~8 years. |
| `AMBR-*-armv7.apk` | **AMBR**, the full app, for older 32-bit phones. |
| `AMBR-*-x86_64.apk` | **AMBR** for emulators and Chromebooks. |
| `AMBR-*-lite.apk` | **AMBR Lite** (~5 MB, any phone): everything except downloading videos from links (YouTube, Reddit, X…). Sharing video *files* to it still works. It's a separate app, so it installs **alongside** AMBR, with its own settings, favorites and hidden folders. Same build as F-Droid. |

The full app is large (~58 MB) because link downloads bundle Python, yt-dlp and FFmpeg.
Want automatic updates? Add this repo to [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium).
